user_feedback_resolved: Three concentric hierarchy tiers; five parents each have three outer child cells, and three parent domains retain white outer gaps.

No text/graphic or text/text overlap; the six-pixel edge proximity test is also clear. Full images visually inspected.

Sector angles express a topic layout, not quantitative data.
Image model generates shapes, colors, lines, and icons. Pillow only adds genuine font glyphs; no texture cleanup or sector rendering.
